title: Route-level vector-ranking health + economics inspector
creator: Aisha Kaur
description: Deliver per-route observability for the embeddings + vector-ranking pipeline (embedding service -> vector store -> scorer -> reranker) with three pillars: 1) health signals (latency P50/P95/P99, error rates, SLI burn), 2) quality monitoring (route-level regression detection using periodic eval sets and sampled user traces), and 3) economics (per-route token/GPU cost breakdown and chargeback-ready metrics). Goal is to enable SRE/Platform and PMs to detect regressions, attribute cost to routes/models, and tie quality alerts to rollout policies.
acceptance_criteria: Per-route dashboard template created in Grafana with latency (p50/p95/p99), errors, traffic, model_variant, backend_pool tags
Tracing available end-to-end for sampled requests from API gateway through embedding lookup to final scorer with span durations and resource tag (gpu_pool, model_variant)
Cost attribution metric exposed per-route and per-model-variant (tokens, inference_ms, estimated_gpu_seconds) with daily and hourly rollups
Alerting rules: SLO latency breach (p95 > X ms), error rate spike (> 3x baseline), and quality regression detection (NDCG drop > 5% over rolling 24h on route eval set)
Runbook written with playbook steps, mitigation knobs (fallback model variant, rate limit, circuit-breaker), and links to relevant dashboards and GitHub PRs
comments: 2026-02-19 - Aisha Kaur: Kickoff meeting with PM and SRE. Decided to prioritize per-route cost attribution + tracing before full sampling of content for privacy reasons.
2026-02-26 - Diego Martinez: Implemented initial trace span format and added gpu_pool and model_variant tags. Opened PR #1257 for review.
2026-03-02 - SRE review (K. O'Neil): Suggested adding a low-overhead sampling strategy (1%) and a separate high-fidelity capture for canary traffic. Added to acceptance criteria.
2026-03-05 - PM (R. Chen): Request to include a quality signal based on the route's canonical eval set, with daily automated NDCG computation and alerting when degradation exceeds threshold.
2026-03-09 - Diego Martinez: Prototype dashboard created. Cost attribution draft uses tokens * model_unit_cost + gpu_seconds * gpu_unit_cost. Need review from FinOps for unit costs accuracy.
2026-03-12 - Aisha Kaur: Merging tracing PR once integration tests pass; plan to run a 48h mirrored canary on staging to validate metrics and alert noise before enabling in prod.
Follow-ups: add an automated query in BI to reconcile chargeback numbers and a short retrospective after the staging canary to iterate alert thresholds.
